#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class CODEFORCES {
private:
    istream& is;
    ostream& out;

    void solve() {
        int a, b, l, r;
        is >> a >> b >> l >> r;
        int cycle = a + b;
        int start = (l - 1) % cycle;
        int count = r - l + 1;
        
        vector<bool> present(26, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            int pos = (start + i) % cycle;
            if (pos < a) present[pos] = true;
            else present[a - 1] = true;
        }
        
        int distinct = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            if (present[i]) distinct++;
        }
        out << distinct << endl;
    }

    void soln() {
        long long s = clock();
        solve();
        out.flush();
        if (getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") == nullptr) {
            cerr << (clock() - s) / (double)CLOCKS_PER_SEC * 1000 << "ms" << endl;
        }
    }

public:
    CODEFORCES(istream& input, ostream& output) : is(input), out(output) {}
    
    void run() {
        soln();
    }
};

int main() {
    CODEFORCES solver(cin, cout);
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
